// Lint fixture: a clean film. Mentions of banned APIs live only in comments, strings, templates and regexes:
// Math.random(), Date.now(), setTimeout(), requestAnimationFrame(), fetch('https://x'), repeat: -1.
/* block comment: new Date() performance.now() crypto.randomUUID() transition: opacity 1s */
import { defineFilm, scene } from '../lib/timeline.js';
import { sp, track } from '../lib/motion.js';
import { rngFor } from '../lib/rng.js';

const NOTE = 'never call Math.random() or Date.now() in a film';
const RULE = /Math\.random|setTimeout\(/g;
const brand = { name: 'Acme', url: 'https://acme.example' }; // shown as text, not fetched
const help = `seek(${1 + 2}) draws frame t; no requestAnimationFrame`;
const ratio = 10 / 2 / 5; // division, not a regex
const dates = { launch: '2026-09-29' };
const repeatCount = 3; // finite
const shot = { name: 'intro', transition: 'wipe' }; // a data field, not CSS

export default defineFilm((ctx) => ({
  scenes: [
    scene(0, 2, 'hook', (g, lt, c) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const r = rngFor('tile', i); // per-element stream created inside the draw
        const x = track(lt, [[0, 0], [0.5, c.W * r()]], 'snappy');
        g.fillRect(x, c.H * r(), 20, 20);
      }
      g.fillText(`${brand.url} · ${NOTE.length} ${help.length} ${dates.launch}`, 10, 10);
      g.globalAlpha = sp(lt - 0.2, 'default') * ratio * repeatCount;
      if (RULE.test(shot.name)) g.fillRect(0, 0, 1, 1);
    }),
  ],
}));
